programs.description: The bachelor of science in Data Science equips students with the essential skills to succeed in the fast-growing field of data science: data analysis, machine learning, and data visualization, with hands-on experience through internships and research projects.
notes: Students must obtain at least a grade of C in all CST courses.

Complete a minimum of 30 credits in residence at City Tech, at least 15 from required courses in the major.
